basic_info.description: Talk about a great location, this amazing top floor condo is filled with light and is an artist's dream. The home makes a bold statement that can only make the viewer happy! Oakwood is one block from Dolores Park and some of the best shops and restaurants in SF; namely Delfina, Bi-Rite and Tartine, all just half a block away.  This flat has two great bedrooms, a bright bath and wonderful eat-in kitchen. Every room has huge windows and are filled with light. At the front of the home is the living room with handsome gas fire place and one of the bedrooms with pocket doors separating the rooms. The second bedroom is at the rear as is the kitchen, both overlook the shared garden as well as out over the neighboring buildings. There are hardwood floors throughout along with high ceilings and loads of period details.  The condo comes with one car parking and tons of storage in the garage along with shared laundry. In 1990 the home had extensive earthquake repairs including a new foundation, shear walls and associated remodeling repairs.  55 Oakwood is in a 3-unit HOA with a magical, newly landscaped shared garden. Seller will consider credits to Buyer. Credit is not binding unless confirmed by separate agreement among the applicable parties. Dues are paid bi-annualy, $3,700 annually.
